title: gpbiometricspy: Python tools for Gazepoint biometric workflows
description: gpbiometricspy is the Python counterpart of gpbiometrics, with gpbiometrics 2.0.0 frozen as its initial semantic reference. It provides Gazepoint-native workflows for EDA/GSR/SCR, PPG/HRV, pupil, gaze, fixation, AOI, TTL/event alignment, multimodal quality control, analysis, plotting, reporting, simulation, reproducibility, and interoperability. Development version 0.1.5.dev0 preserves the complete 406-export scientific contract and 100% statement coverage, adds physiology measurement-accountability methods, expands installed Studio replay/production validation, and retains audited branch-path enforcement with zero unaudited branch debt. Stable citation metadata remain pinned separately to the actual 0.1.4 release until a future 0.1.5 stable freeze is completed.
